Another defeat, their 11th of the calendar year - more than they had in 2025, with three months of this year to go. At least two goals conceded for the fifth straight Premier League game under Alonso. More set-piece woe. metadata.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months.
metadata.content: Max Dowman: Mikel Arteta admits 16-year-old Arsenal wonderkid could go out on loan in the future | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Max Dowman: Mikel Arteta admits 16-year-old Arsenal wonderkid could go out on loan in the future Max Dowman impressed in Arsenal's win over Ipswich, underlying his position as one of the best young players in the game; the 16-year-old could be sent out on loan - he has only played one game this season; Mikel Arteta: "We have to be open, but now the focus is to be here." Sam Blitz Football Journalist @SamBIitz Friday 18 September 2026 23:52, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta speaks on the potential loan move for midfield youngster Max Dowman. Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has not ruled out loaning out Max Dowman in the future and says the club evaluates the 16-year-old sensation's progress every six months. Dowman continued his rise by starting and scoring twice in Arsenal's Carabao Cup win over Ipswich this week. After the game, Gunners midfielder Mikel Merino compared the young teenager to Barcelona and Spain star Lamine Yamal. But those 90 minutes at Portman Road have been Dowman's only minutes of the season, and he did not make Arsenal's matchday squad in the wins over Aston Villa and Sunderland.
